title: Weighted Word Mapping
summary: Given an array of words with lowercase English letters and an array of weights for each letter, calculate the weight of each word by summing the weights of its characters, then map the result modulo 26 to a lowercase letter in reverse alphabetical order, and return the concatenated string of these mapped letters.
statement: Given an array of words with lowercase English letters and an array of weights for each letter, calculate the weight of each word by summing the weights of its characters, then map the result modulo 26 to a lowercase letter in reverse alphabetical order, and return the concatenated string of these mapped letters.
constraints: words contains nonempty lowercase English strings and weights has exactly 26 integers.
Sum the supplied weight of every character in each word.
Map remainder r to the reverse-alphabet letter at index 25-r and concatenate the results.
hints: Each word is independent: only its total weight modulo 26 matters.
Use character codes to index the 26 weights, then reflect the remainder across the alphabet.
Accumulate one mapped character per word in the original order.
The sum matches the definition, modulo preserves the requested class, and code point 122-r is exactly the reverse-alphabet mapping.

Both totals are zero, and reverse index zero is z, so the result is zz.
